environmentsTab.title: Environments
environmentsTab.branchIsEnvironment: An environment is a branch of this organization's model. Creating one copies the model it is branched from; merging carries changes back. Choose which environment you are working in from the switcher in the top bar.
environmentsTab.noRemote: This organization has no git remote, so its model lives only on this server. Set one under Integration to have every change mirrored off it.
environmentsTab.inheritHelp: On, this environment reads its source connections — host, port, database, username — from the environment it was created from, by reference. Nothing is copied, so a rotation there is picked up here with nothing to do, and a revocation revokes here too.
environmentsTab.inheritHelp2: Leave it off — the default — to get the whole model with none of the connections: the new environment starts unbound and you point each source at your own database. That is what you want making a dev environment from prod, and it is why turning this on has to be a deliberate act.
environmentsTab.deleted: Deleted {{env}}. Its branch remains in the repository.
environmentsTab.protectedHelp: A merge into a protected environment is not applied when it is requested. It is proposed, and someone other than the person who requested it approves it.
environmentsTab.protectedHelp2: prod is protected on its own once the org has a second member, whatever this switch says — before that there is nobody who could approve, and the rule would leave prod unmergeable.
environmentsTab.driftedHelp: The last model change could not be committed to the repository. The model itself was saved — the projection is behind.
environmentsTab.pullUpToDate: {{env}} already holds what the remote has.
environmentsTab.deleteHelp: The environment's schemas and its row go. Its branch stays unless you say otherwise, and the branch is what keeps the work loadable afterwards.
environmentsTab.deleteBranchHelp: Without the branch there is no record of what this environment held, and nothing to load it back from.
environmentsTab.deleteRemoteBranch: Delete its branch on the remote too
environmentsTab.deleteRemoteBranchHelp: The copy on the git host is what survives a lost volume, so it is deleted only alongside the local branch and never instead of it.
environmentsTab.mergeIntoHelp: Defaults to where this environment was branched from. Change it to carry the work somewhere else.
environmentsTab.noMergeTarget: This environment was not branched from another, so choose where the work should go.
environmentsTab.removalsHelp: Objects the source no longer has are removed from the target. Left off, a merge only adds and changes.
environmentsTab.retireSourceHelp: The environment's schema and its row go; the work itself is in the target by then. Off by default.
environmentsTab.retireRemote: Delete its branch on the remote too
environmentsTab.retireRemoteHelp: The copy on the git host is what survives a lost volume, so this is offered only alongside deleting the environment and never instead of it.
environmentsTab.mergeMessageHelp: Required. The commit/merge message. Describe the intent behind these changes.
environmentsTab.requestReviewHelp: Where the target branch is governed by pull requests on the git host, the review happens there. This pushes the branch and opens the request with the comment above as its description.
environmentsTab.mergeProposed: Proposed a merge into {{env}} for approval.
environmentsTab.deployRefHelp: The branch is resolved to a commit now, and that commit is what is applied. If the branch moves afterwards, this deploy does not.
environmentsTab.deployMessageHelp: This environment is protected, so the deploy is proposed for someone else to approve. Say what this build contains.
environmentsTab.deployProposed: Proposed a deploy into {{env}} for approval.
environmentsTab.pickFile: Select a file to view it at this ref.
environmentsTab.integrationSecretHint: The remote is stored exactly as typed and resolved only when a push happens. Write a secret reference such as ${env:GIT_TOKEN} rather than a token.
environmentsTab.remoteHelp: Where this organization's model is mirrored. Clear the field to stop mirroring.
environmentsTab.webhookHelp: Where the result of each push is reported.
environmentsTab.integrationProjection: The repository is a projection of the model, never its authority.
environmentsTab.probeHint: Checking is read-only. A repository is created only if you ask for it here — a missing one is as likely to be a typo as an omission, and mirroring into an address nobody meant leaves the intended repository empty.
environmentsTab.conflictsTitle: {{count}} object(s) changed on both sides since these environments parted. The merge applies the source, overwriting the target's version.
environmentsTab.conflictsNotCompared: These environments share no common ancestor, so nothing could be compared — this is not the same as no conflicts.
environmentsTab.mergedOverwriting: Merged into {{env}}, overwriting {{count}} object(s) changed there.
environmentsTab.pulledOverwriting: Pulled {{env}} from the remote, overwriting {{count}} object(s) changed here since these lines parted:
